import.title: Import tavern card
import.scopeGlobal: This will be imported as a global preset that every instance can see
import.scopeInstance: This will be imported into instance {{instance}}
import.scopeUnknown: This will be imported into the current instance
import.fileHint: Accepts .png and .json, up to {{size}} (the platform upload size limit also applies)
import.fileTooLarge: The file is larger than {{size}}. You can export the card as JSON in SillyTavern and import that instead
import.noFile: Choose a character card file first
import.name: Name
import.creator: Author
import.longContent: Every prompt round will carry this many characters
import.instructionsNotice: These texts are sent to the model as part of the preset; the administrator who imports them is responsible for their content.
import.postHistoryGateOn: Advanced prompt slots are enabled on this instance, so this will be sent
import.postHistoryGateOff: Advanced prompt slots are disabled on this instance; this is saved but not sent
import.rewriteNameVarsHint: When the card stores the user's or character's name in a variable, NA cannot read it; replacing it with a macro is what makes the name show up. Only writes that output a name are replaced, and the import report lists what was changed.
import.bookGateOn: Entries only take effect when worldbook is enabled on the channel (currently enabled on this instance)
import.bookGateOff: Entries only take effect when worldbook is enabled on the channel (currently disabled on this instance)
import.bookReferenceHint: Imported entries are treated as reference material; the platform can promote them one by one on the worldbook page
import.rulesEmpty: This card has no cleanup rules
import.rulesHint: Only switches that differ from the defaults are submitted. Among rules that are off by default, only those disabled in the card itself or whose replacement contains HTML can be enabled here.
import.ruleDisabledReason: Why it is off by default
import.htmlKindHint: The replacement is web code that QQ cannot display and NA does not render; use "keep the text only" or "drop the whole match" instead
import.unsupported: Parts of this card the platform cannot use
import.slotsAskTitle: Also turn on advanced prompt slots for this instance?
import.slotsAskBody: This card has post-history instructions, but advanced prompt slots are off on this instance: if you only import, they are saved but not sent.
import.slotsAskGlobalOff: They are off globally as well: this sets an instance-level override for this instance only; other instances are not affected.
import.slotsAskInstanceLevel: This turns on an instance-level override for this instance and is recorded in the configuration change log.
import.slotsAskChannelsOff: These chats turn the slots off on their own and still won't send after the instance is turned on:
import.slotsResultEnabled: Advanced prompt slots are now on for this instance; post-history instructions will be sent.
import.slotsResultAlready: Advanced prompt slots were already on for this instance; nothing changed.
import.slotsResultFailed: Imported, but the slots were not turned on: {{reason}}
import.slotsResultChannelsOff: These chats turn the slots off on their own and still won't send:
import.remoteBooksHint: After importing the preset you can download them here or on the preset page.

share.cardWarning: Sharing uploads the card source, post-history instructions, prefill, greetings, output cleanup rules and every character book you can see to NekroCloud. The card source may contain jailbreak text, and it will leave this instance with the upload.

reason.not_ai_output: In the card this rule only applies to user input or other places, not to AI replies; the platform only cleans AI replies, so this rule is off by default
reason.disabled_in_card: It is already switched off in the card; enable it here if you need it
reason.prompt_only: The card applies it only to the prompt sent to the model; the platform cleans outgoing text and stores the cleaned version, so this rule is unnecessary
reason.find_macros: The find pattern uses macros, which the platform does not support yet, so this rule is off by default
reason.depth_limited: It applies only to messages deeper than a set depth; the platform only cleans the message just sent, so this rule is off by default
reason.invalid_regex: The regular expression does not compile, so it cannot run; this rule is off by default
reason.unsafe_regex: The regular expression failed the safety check because it could stall the service; this rule is off by default
reason.html_output: The replacement contains HTML tags; enabling it as "keep the text only" would fail the save check, so it stays off. Edit out the tags and then enable it

extension.title: Tavern extension
extension.closeConfirm: The tavern extension has unsaved changes. Close anyway?
extension.readOnly: Global presets are read-only in an instance view
extension.empty: This preset has no tavern extension yet. After you save once, greetings, depth prompt, cleanup rules and the rest take effect.
extension.notFoundHint: There is no such record, or it is not in an instance you can manage.
extension.saveFailed: Could not save the tavern extension

identity.nicknameHint: {{char}} uses the nickname first and falls back to the preset name
identity.macrosHint: When on, {{char}}, {{user}} and other macros in the preset content are expanded every round; when off, the content is sent to the model verbatim. Macros in greetings, depth prompt, slots and worldbook entries are not affected by this switch

source.assembled: The preset content matches the assembled result
source.modified: The preset content was edited by hand (or never assembled)
source.reassembleConfirm: Regenerate the preset content from the current assembly template? This overwrites any hand-written content in the Basic tab.
source.reassembleFailed: Could not reassemble the preset content

greetings.tooLong: Longer than {{n}} characters; the server will reject it on save
greetings.hint: Greetings are no longer sent to the chat; they are kept with the card and exported unchanged.

slots.gateOn: Advanced prompt slots are enabled on this instance, so both blocks are sent
slots.gateOff: Advanced prompt slots are disabled on this instance: both blocks are saved but not sent (a channel can enable them separately)
slots.responsibility: The administrator is responsible for the content, its consequences and the compliance of the corresponding key
slots.prefillHint: Only sent to model groups whose prefill mode is not off; when prefill leads the reply outside a code block, this round retries once

depth.depthHint: Inserted before the Nth message from the end of the chat history; 0 means after the last one
depth.invalid: Depth must be an integer from {{min}} to {{max}}

rules.name: Name

outputModeHint.replace: Replace the match with the replacement text (the original behavior)
outputModeHint.text: Keep only the text in the captured groups; HTML and fixed text are dropped

rules.htmlKindHint: The replacement is web code that QQ cannot display and NA does not render; use "keep the text only" or "drop the whole match" instead
rules.reimportNote: For HTML rules, the on/off state and handling chosen here only decide what NA sends; they are not written into the exported card, and importing the card again restores the card's on/off state and the default handling
rules.htmlEnableHint: This rule's replacement is web code: the switch and handling here only decide what NA sends; they are not written into the exported card, and importing it again restores the card's settings
rules.manualReason: You chose not to enable this rule during import; enable it here if you need it
rules.regexError: Does not compile in the browser: {{error}}. The server checks it again with its own rules on save
rules.slowDisabledHint: This rule timed out 3 times in this process and has been paused; saving the rule table once resets the count

remoteBooks.title: Remote worldbooks
remoteBooks.intro: Scripts in the card download these worldbooks while running in SillyTavern. NA does not run scripts: after you confirm, it downloads them on your behalf and imports them as reference material for this preset (entries are not treated as trusted content). They are not updated automatically.
remoteBooks.checkNotImported: This book is not imported yet; refresh to download it again
remoteBooks.notesHint: {{n}} import notes; see the worldbook page
remoteBooks.downloadFailed: Could not download the remote worldbook
remoteBooks.confirmBody: The new version replaces every entry in this book, including entries you edited by hand.

state.pending: Not sent (round failed or ended early)
state.unsupported: Model group does not support prefill

lab.title: Prompt Lab
lab.subtitle: See the full prompt a channel will send to the model this round, or trial it with your own model group
lab.scopeBanner: Preview, trial and audit all follow the current instance scope; changing the instance resets the form and results

preview.greetingNotSent: This preview will not send a greeting
preview.samplePlaceholder: Optional; it is appended to the chat history as the last message
preview.notice: Preview does not run memory recall or plugin dynamic injection; those two show placeholders. It does not call the model and writes nothing.
preview.botOffline: The bot of this channel is offline, so its own platform account is shown as a placeholder in the prompt; everything else matches a real round.
preview.presetOverrideNote: Previewing another persona: its text, advanced slots, greeting, depth prompt and persona worldbook are used; the chat summary and affection block still follow the chat's current persona (they belong to the persona's memory partition, which the preview does not switch).
preview.rpPrefill: Prefill: not sent in this version

rpInactive.slots_off: This channel has not enabled "Advanced prompt slots", so the preset will not take effect
rpInactive.tavern_off: This channel's persona does not use the Tavern-compatible runtime, so the preset will not take effect
rpInactive.unavailable: The preset selected for this channel no longer exists or does not belong to this instance, so it will not take effect
